name: Tool_RAG
description: Retrieve related tools from the toolbox based on the provided description

description.description: The description of the tool capability required.

limit.description: The number of tools to retrieve (default: 10)

embedding_model.description: Optional: embedding encoder to use for this search. 'default' = the fine-tuned ToolRAG-T1 (1.5B); 'gte-qwen2-7b' and 'e5-mistral-7b' are larger open encoders with higher accuracy (downloaded on first use, GPU recommended); 'openai-3-large'/'openai-3-small' use hosted OpenAI embeddings (require OpenAI/Azure credentials). Defaults to 'default'.

test_examples.description: Find tools that can perform sequence alignment

name: Tool_Finder_Jev
description: Tool finder that retrieves a wide BM25 shortlist and grades every candidate with a decision model, for higher accuracy than embedding search without a GPU. Requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

description.description: The description of the tool capability required.

limit.description: The number of tools to retrieve (default: 10)

picked_tool_names.description: Pre-selected tool names to process. If provided, retrieval and grading are skipped.

return_call_result.description: Whether to return both prompts and tool names. If false, returns only tool prompts.

categories.description: Optional list of tool categories to filter by

test_examples.description: predict the three-dimensional structure of a protein from its amino-acid sequence
look up which drugs target a given gene in an oncology knowledge base

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.purpose: Grade retrieved tool candidates for relevance so Tool_Finder_Jev can rank them.
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.without: Tool_Finder_Jev is not loaded; the other tool finders are unaffected.
